description: AMS Pasadena Main Data is a dataset listed in data.transportation.gov (U.S. DOT open data portal), an open data portal of the U.S. Department of Transportation under the section "Research and Statistics", published or maintained by U.S. Department of Transportation’s (USDOT) Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS) Joint Program Office (JPO) -- Recommended citation: "U.S. Department of Transportation Intelligent Transportation Systems Joint Program Office. (2014). AMS Pasadena Main Data. [Dataset]. Provided by ITS DataHub through Data.transportation.gov. Accessed YYYY-MM-DD from http://doi.org/10.21949/1504481". The data in this data environment was collected from the Pasadena, California testbed, namely I-210, SR 134, and nearby arterials. The source of these data is from the Caltrans – Performance Measurement System (PeMS). Speed data from this dataset were used to derive the freeway travel time. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Research and Statistics". It has 42 columns, among them Number of Samples, 5-minute Flows for Lane 7, Type of Facility, 5-minute Speeds for Lane 7, 5-minute Speeds Lane 3, 5-minute Occupancy for Lane 2. The portal shows 2017-09-21 as the last data update. Attribution given: U.S. Department of Transportation’s (USDOT) Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS) Joint Program Office (JPO) -- Recom. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution | Noncommercial | Share Alike 3.0 Unported. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-usdot-data-transportation-gov-portal.
